name: Owensboro Health

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
By the county each hospital sits in, as CMS records it.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Muhlenberg Community Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Owensboro Health hospitals; Regional Hospital has the most, 2,130. About 10.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Regional Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other Owensboro Health hospital reports more; Muhlenberg Community Hospital is next at 471. About 7.1 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Twin Lakes Medical Center have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 Owensboro Health hospitals; Regional Hospital has the most, 2,130. About 5.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Regional Hospital in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do Owensboro Health's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: What percent of Muhlenberg Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other Owensboro Health hospital runs higher; Twin Lakes Medical Center is next at 58 percent. Traditional Medicare was 35 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 38 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Regional Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Owensboro Health hospitals; Muhlenberg Community Hospital runs highest, 73 percent. Traditional Medicare was 23 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 29 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Twin Lakes Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Owensboro Health hospitals; Muhlenberg Community Hospital runs highest, 73 percent. Traditional Medicare was 26 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 32 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Muhlenberg Community Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 Owensboro Health hospitals; Twin Lakes Medical Center runs highest, 36 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 12 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Regional Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 Owensboro Health hospitals; Twin Lakes Medical Center runs highest, 36 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 3 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 26 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Twin Lakes Medical Center's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other Owensboro Health hospital runs higher; Regional Hospital is next at 29 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 1 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 35 percent.

questions.q: Across all of Owensboro Health's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?

questions.q: Across all of Owensboro Health's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does Owensboro Health run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Kentucky. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many of Owensboro Health's hospitals are outside a metropolitan area?
